Nostalgia Critic teams up with Saberspark to look over the 2007 film Noah's Ark (El Arca) as they try to figure out what they were thinking. Let's hope we don't get a full answer to that.

Noah's Ark (Spanish: El Arca) is a 2007 animated comedy film directed by Juan Pablo Buscarini. Based on the biblical story of Noah's Ark, its story is told from the animals' point of view. The film tends to follow the traditional story, with the animals being anthropomorphic.
